description: Public phase 3 topline numbers that no model reads yet. Each lacks something the models need (arm sizes here), and the pre-registered models v0.4 and v0.5 are defined by topline-results.json, so adding rows there would change them. Moving a row into a fit needs a new pre-registered model version.
